description.value: Very Berry Cafe is part of Mabel Lake Farms, a four-generation family operation near Kingfisher and Mabel Lake in the Thompson-Okanagan region of BC. The farm has grown spray-free blueberries since 1980 and the cafe serves as the on-site retail outlet for fresh blueberries during the summer season. The broader property includes a primitive campground beside Kingfisher Creek, with Mabel Lake and the Shuswap River both within easy reach — making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring this quiet rural corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Very Berry Cafe website page itself contains almost no descriptive content, but the broader Mabel Lake Farms site confirms an active, multi-generational family operation near Kingfisher/Mabel Lake with a cafe that sells spray-free blueberries in summer months. The contact page provides a phone number (250-838-6248) not in OSM. No amenity-specific evidence (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) appears anywhere on the website, so those fields are null. The site's © 2026 date and active campground booking email suggest the business is currently operating.
